Deprecated: use condition_miss_index()

mnar_index.Rd

mnar_index() has been renamed to condition_miss_index() to better reflect that the index summarises missingness predictable from experimental condition, not MNAR in the classical sense. All arguments are identical; this wrapper calls the new function and will be removed in a future release.

Usage

mnar_index(...)

Details

Note: condition_miss_index() expects the $summary output from condition_miss_score(), which uses updated column names (condition_miss_score, condition_miss_class) rather than the old mnar_score / mnar_class names.

See also

condition_miss_index
